name: Side chat
description: Ask an agent about its work with /btw, without interrupting it or reaching its transcript.
author: Seti

commands.title: Ask aside
commands.description: Asks an agent's context, as a side chat: the answer comes from everything it saw, never interrupts it and never reaches its transcript. Use it for why an agent did something or what it found. It can take a few minutes and costs a model call charged to that agent.

question.description: The question for its context, such as why it chose an approach.

slashCommands.name: btw
slashCommands.description: Ask a side question; the agent is not interrupted

views.title: Side chat
views.description: Stays out of the agent's chat
